T01.text: Artificial Intelligence will improve society more than it will create problems.

T02.text: Generative AI tools should be allowed as learning aids in higher education.

T03.text: Students should disclose the use of AI in assignments and reports.

T04.text: Every engineering student should receive formal education in AI.

T05.text: Artificial Intelligence will significantly accelerate scientific discovery.

T06.text: Most repetitive jobs will eventually be replaced by intelligent automation.

T07.text: Robots should replace humans in hazardous occupations whenever possible.

T08.text: AI-assisted diagnosis should become routine in healthcare.

T09.text: Autonomous vehicles will ultimately make transportation safer.

T10.text: Protection of personal data is more important than technological convenience.

T11.text: Technology companies should explain how recommendation algorithms work.

T12.text: Governments should introduce stricter regulations for Artificial Intelligence.

T13.text: Cybersecurity deserves greater investment than the development of new digital technologies.

T14.text: Social media algorithms contribute to opinion polarization.

T15.text: Society will increasingly depend on AI-assisted decision making.

E01.text: Project-based learning develops deeper understanding than examination-oriented learning.

E02.text: Traditional written examinations accurately measure a student's knowledge.

E03.text: Class attendance should be compulsory for all courses.

E04.text: High-quality online learning can effectively complement classroom teaching.

E05.text: Students should be encouraged to take courses outside their primary discipline.

E06.text: Every undergraduate student should participate in at least one research project.

E07.text: Publishing research before graduation should be encouraged, but not mandatory.

E08.text: Maintaining academic honesty is more important than obtaining high grades.

E09.text: Collaborative learning is generally more effective than individual learning.

E10.text: Universities should prioritize innovation and problem-solving over rote learning.

E11.text: University curricula should be updated more frequently to match emerging technologies.

E12.text: Artificial intelligence should be integrated into teaching and personalized learning.

E13.text: Universities should invest more resources in research than in expanding infrastructure.

E14.text: Strong collaborations between universities and industry improve student education.

E15.text: Continuous learning and skill development are essential throughout one's career.

S01.text: Every individual has a responsibility to contribute positively to society.

S02.text: Universities should encourage students to participate in community service activities.

S03.text: New technologies should be evaluated for their societal impact before widespread deployment.

S04.text: Technology companies should be accountable for unethical use of their platforms.

S05.text: Individuals should have greater control over how their personal data are collected and used.

S06.text: Combating online misinformation requires shared responsibility among users, platforms, and governments.

S07.text: Equal opportunities should be prioritized regardless of a person's background.

S08.text: Diverse teams generally make better decisions than homogeneous teams.

S09.text: Universities should promote an inclusive environment where different viewpoints can be discussed respectfully.

S10.text: Scientific evidence should play an important role in public policy decisions.

S11.text: People should be free to express differing opinions as long as they do not promote harm or discrimination.

S12.text: Young people should actively participate in addressing societal challenges.

S13.text: Critical evaluation of online information should be taught as a core educational skill.

S14.text: Leaders should prioritize ethical decision-making even when it reduces short-term gains.

S15.text: Building public trust is essential for responsible adoption of emerging technologies.

V01.text: Climate change requires immediate global action.

V02.text: Governments should prioritize investment in renewable energy over fossil fuels.

V03.text: Individuals should actively reduce their personal energy consumption.

V04.text: Public transportation and non-motorized transport should be promoted even if they require additional public investment.

V05.text: Single-use plastics should be significantly restricted.

V06.text: Water conservation should be a priority in households, institutions, and industries.

V07.text: Protecting biodiversity is essential for long-term human well-being.

V08.text: Universities should adopt environmentally sustainable campus practices even if implementation costs increase.

V09.text: Products should be designed to encourage reuse, repair, and recycling.

V10.text: Consumers should consider environmental impact when purchasing products.

V11.text: Technological innovation is essential for addressing environmental challenges.

V12.text: Environmental sustainability should be integrated into higher education curricula.

V13.text: Companies should be held accountable for the environmental impacts of their activities.

V14.text: International cooperation is necessary to effectively address environmental challenges.

V15.text: Current generations have a responsibility to protect natural resources for future generations.
